profile.headline: Senior Analyst, Full-Stack Developer at Avanade
profile.summary: B.S. in Game Design from USCS, graduated from Revature as a .NET Full-Stack developer.

positions.title: Senior Services Engineer
positions.description: Managed service engineering team on Payment Central project by hosting regularly scheduled meetings to assist domestic and international teammates in overcoming blockers, encouraged behavior of actively searching for solutions and workarounds to known issues to increase team's overall performance.

positions.title: Piano Teacher
positions.description: Teaching up to twenty students weekly, split between my home studio and students’ homes. I regularly coordinate with parents of many backgrounds to ensure efficient and positive learning experiences at home.

positions.title: Level Designer
positions.description: In a six-person team, I was the level designer and artist coordinator, using Unity and Blender, I designed levels, coded a system for lighting patterns, and assisted project manager in organizing play-test sessions and relayed relevant information to team members.

positions.title: Front End Programmer
positions.description: Front end web programmer using Parse’s JavaScript SDK for a food delivering app called Nibble.

positions.title: Grader and Tutor for Algorithms and Abstract Data Types
positions.description: Performed in person evaluation of student’s programming assignments.  Assisted students with programming assignment questions including binary search trees and multiple  sorting algorithms.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: A 2D game coded in JavaScript using Brine framework.  My various contributions include collision detection, enemy pathing, object design and level design.

projects.title: Inure
projects.description:
A Six Degrees of Freedom SHMUP that put the player in control of a spaceship sent to destroy a giant alien structure from within. Contributed to level design using blender, miscellaneous lighting and object placements.
The game's website: https://inure.itch.io/inure

projects.title: Nibble
projects.description:
Food servicing app that allows a driver to take orders from users and deliver to a general location for pickup, developed during Introduction to Software Engineering.
In a six person team, I was the front end web programmer developing using Parse’s JavaScript SDK.
